title: Stir-Fried Flaxseed Pancakes
description: A Chinese-inspired twist on traditional pancakes, featuring flaxseed for added nutrition and a velvety texture. Serve with a tangy sour sauce.

ingredients.name: velvety
ingredients.notes: or substitute with plant-based milk alternative

ingredients.name: sour
ingredients.notes: such as rice vinegar or apple cider vinegar

instructions: 1. In a large bowl, combine flaxseed and milk. Let sit for 5 minutes to thicken.
2. Add vinegar and stir to combine.
3. Heat oil in a non-stick pan over medium heat.
4. Pour in the flaxseed mixture and cook for 2-3 minutes, until the bottom is golden brown.
5. Flip the pancakes and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
6. In a small bowl, mix together flour and a pinch of salt. Sprinkle over the pancakes.
7. Cook for an additional 30 seconds to 1 minute, until the flour is lightly toasted.
8. Serve hot with a drizzle of sour sauce, if desired.
9. To make the sour sauce, combine 1/2 cup sour cream or yogurt with 1 tbsp vinegar and 1 tsp honey. Mix well.
11. Garnish with chopped scallions or sesame seeds, if desired.
